method: Three exploratory performance-gate trials; no numerical or candidate reduction; all10 original GPU instruction bodies and resource counts identical.
decision: Adopt the simpler measured floor64 separately; preserve these below64 variants and raw measurements without claiming a stable overall benefit.

trials.name: bvh_compact_order
trials.reason: Unconditional order floor32: cold 16,384-ray traces at 32/48 triangles increased 10.8%/15.9%, consistently in all three round pairs.

trials.name: bvh_balanced_order
trials.reason: Keep the large-batch candidate floor64 but capture from32: the 48-triangle/4096-ray cold boundary did not improve; two of three round pairs regressed.

trials.name: bvh_small_batch
trials.reason: Use cached serial above1024 rays below64 triangles: nonexclusive-host timing varied strongly across shapes and rounds; insufficient evidence to adopt the added cutoff.
